text:
Maya Patel: Kicking off canary traffic shift for release/realtime-inference v2 in eu-west-1. Plan: 10% -> 50% over 15m. Helm values updated in chart-release PR 482. @Kevin Liu, watch GPU provisioning.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: realtime-inference v2 - canary: 10% -> 50% - window 15m

Kevin Liu: seeing higher queuing on pods in eu-west-1, traces show long scheduling wait for p4d instances :thinking_face:

Rob Chen: checked ASG scaling events — cloud quotas blocking new P4d launches. AWS account quota for p4d.gpu is at 12, we requested 20 for the canary burst.

Maya Patel: ugh. did we not validate resource requests during the preflight? Our pull-runner should have flagged this.

Anita Gomez: GitOps diff shows terraform autoscaling config in staging vs prod diverged. Prod has max_unavailable=0 in the rollout strategy so new nodes couldn't be spun for safety reasons.

Maya Patel: rollback canary to 0% and abort automated traffic shift. @ci-bot please revert canary percentage.

ci-bot: Rolling back canary: set canary=0% for realtime-inference v2 via Argo Rollouts. Action: rollback triggered by user maya.patel

Kevin Liu: creating uplift request with infra to increase GPU quota; may need approval. ETA ~2 hours if quota request goes through.

Rob Chen: short-term option: move canary to us-east-1 where we have spare capacity, or run reduced batch-size to fit existing nodes. Both have tradeoffs (latency or perf variance).

Maya Patel: prefer avoiding cross-region canary for model-sensitive latency tests. Let's do reduced batch-size and re-run canary once quota is resolved.

Anita Gomez: Will file a tiny helm override: set batch_size: 8 -> 4 and kv_cache: false for canary to lower mem. Pushing PR to infra/helm-values #512 with a values override snippet:

```yaml
realtimeInference:
  resources:
    limits:
      nvidia.com/gpu: 1
  runtime:
    batch_size: 4
    kv_cache: false
```

Kevin Liu: noted cost implications — smaller batch increases per-token overhead but cheaper than emergency spot/overprovision. Tagging finance for short-term bump? @Rob Chen

Rob Chen: FYI opened support ticket with AWS (case #15233444). If quota denied, we fallback to blue/green in us-east later.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Owners: @Anita (helm override + PR), @Kevin (quota ticket + monitor), @Rob (fallback plan). We'll re-run canary after greencheck. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary aborted by user maya.patel. Status: rolled back to 0%. Events logged in #deployments.
